reasoning: The remaining step is git push to the public remote plus gh release create, which puts the tag and artifacts in front of strangers and 'cannot be taken back cleanly once it lands.' The skill's closing rule ('A shown result closes the work') explicitly carves this out: 'This changes nothing about rule 12's own ground -- an action that is genuinely irreversible outside git still stops for his word before it runs, never only after it is shown.' Everything up to publishing (version file, changelog, tag message, green suite, publish checklist) is an ordinary delivered result and would close on its own, but the publish action itself is the reserved irreversible case, so the Director must hold the checkpoint open and get the person's word before running git push/gh release create, not close the work now.
